name: Iris
author: alanfortlink
description: System-wide camera effects (Center Stage, Portrait, Studio Light, Backgrounds, Filters, Fun face filters, Reactions, Block camera) exposed as the "Iris Camera" virtual webcam, with a Control-Center-style panel in the bar.

barWidget.description: Camera effects panel with live preview; the icon lights up while an app is using the camera.

schema.label: Show icon even when no app is using the camera
